thread:
maria: Quick UX pass request on the Compliance > Data settings screen — a few security/copy/accessibility nits I noticed. Can we brain-dump here and I’ll consolidate into a tiny PR?

alex: Saw it this morning. Biggest pain: the retention control is ambiguous. It currently says `Data retention (days)` with a free-number input. People keep entering odd values. Suggest: change label to `Retention period` + a dropdown with presets (30 / 90 / 365 / Custom). Add helper text: 'How long we keep request and audit logs for this workspace.'

josh: Agreed on presets. Also we should call out the legal/data-residency implication when region != storage region. Maybe a small badge: `Stored in eu-west-1` with a tooltip: 'Data residency: requests and logs stored in this region.'

sasha: KMS copy is confusing right now. Current label: `Encryption key`. Propose: `Customer-managed key (KMS)` and beneath it smaller copy: 'Use your own KMS key to encrypt stored logs. Requires role xyz/permissions.' Add a link to the docs.

andy: Accessibility nits: 1) The retention dropdown isn't keyboard-navigable right now (tabbing skips the presets). 2) The warning text uses #d9534f on white — contrast fails for AA. 3) The KMS toggle has no aria-label, screen readers announce it as "checkbox" only. We need aria-labels like `Enable customer-managed key` and ensure focus outlines are visible.

alex: Good call. Design change: move helper copy under the field, not inline; makes it easier for screen readers. Also add the `aria-describedby` id on the input to point to helper text.

maria: On audit logs copy — current line: 'Audit logs retained for X days'. Legal wants it to be explicit: 'Audit logs are retained for N days unless an export is performed. Contact support to extend retention.' Is that too scary for product pages?

kyle: From legal: fine to be explicit. Also request a one-click export CTA and clear TTL display per log type (api requests, system events).

josh: Implementation note: exporting larger-than-30-day ranges will kick off async job. Sam-bot can post status messages back. We should surface that in copy: 'Large exports may take up to 24 hours; you will be notified.'

sasha: Small copy tweak for region dropdown: show both friendly name + code: `Europe (eu-west-1)` and add a tiny warning for cross-region replication: 'Selecting a region different from your workspace's billing region may affect latency and compliance.' Keep short.

andy: Also, for keyboard users the region selector should support type-to-search and arrow navigation. Screen reader should announce region + residency info, e.g., 'Europe, stored in eu-west-1, GDPR region'.

alex: Visual: move the KMS toggle and key-id field into an expandable panel titled 'Encryption' so it doesn't clutter the main form. Panel should have summary: 'Customer-managed keys: off' and when expanded show the form + helper links. Keeps the page lighter.

maria: UX question: when user turns on KMS, should we block changing retention? Security might want it immutable for a short window. Thoughts?

josh: We shouldn't block client-side, but show a banner: 'Changing retention while KMS is enabled will create a new encryption context.' And on the back-end enforce a review step if retention decreases below 30 days with CMK enabled (policy TBD).

kyle: Add a sentence about auditability: 'All KMS key changes are recorded in the workspace audit log.' Simple line under the panel.

sasha: For microcopy examples (to give to docs):
- Retention label: `Retention period`
- Helper: `How long we keep request and audit logs for this workspace.`
- KMS label: `Customer-managed key (KMS)`
- KMS helper: `Use your own KMS key to encrypt stored logs. Requires ` + code `kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt` + ' on the key. See docs.'
- Region tooltip: `Data residency: requests and logs are stored in <region>.`

andy: Accessibility sample aria values: `aria-label="Enable customer-managed key"`, `aria-describedby="retention-help"`, `role="region" aria-labelledby="encryption-panel-title"`. Also ensure color tokens for warnings are >4.5:1 when used for text.

alex: I'll mock a quick modal and update the design system tokens. Will post screenshot later (will attach `screenshot-17132.png`).

maria: Thanks — @alex when you post the screenshot can you also include the exact copy lines? I'll bundle into an RFC and file a tiny UI PR.

sam-bot: Deployment note: staging feature flag `compliance-ui-v2` ready for QA.

maria: Perfect. If no objections I’ll consolidate these nits into a single doc and assign to @sasha for the PR. :thumbsup:

kyle: +1 from legal.

josh: +1 from security, add backend policy link when you create the RFC.

andy: Will do an a11y checklist for the PR review.

alex: will upload mock by EOD.

maria: Closing loop — thanks everyone!
